nodes.label: Research completion status
nodes.rationale: Completed expanded, assisted and original studies have separate frozen selections. Historical pause records are provenance, not an instruction to restart completed work.

nodes.label: Expanded RTE-feature and cold-risk protocol
nodes.rationale: Development extends into winter 2025; separate spring calibration has no cold-evening observations. Supplied RTE D1 is assumed available before cutoff, and test outcomes were previously inspected.

nodes.label: Original research_v2 protocol
nodes.rationale: Chronological 2024 tuning and January–June 2025 calibration are distinct from the expanded protocol. Forecast vintages and historical release timing remain unverified.

nodes.label: Retrospective evidence boundary
nodes.rationale: Unverified demand/RTE/weather vintages, prior test exposure, bounded neural optimization and mismatched training anchors prevent operational-superiority or general architecture claims.

nodes.label: Causal national, regional-only and combined predictor views
nodes.rationale: All views predict national consumption; regional-only excludes national history but retains national RTE/calendar. Publication gating masks unavailable lags and excludes future realized weather.

nodes.label: Separate point, quantile and fixed-conformal constructions
nodes.rationale: Point selection uses cold-weighted development MAE and guardrails; quantile selection uses overall development WIS. Fixed conformal/CQR comparators do not share the refitted point predictor or establish temporal/conditional coverage.

nodes.label: Legacy quarterly evaluation protocol
nodes.rationale: Older scripts/evaluation.py and baseline JSON artifacts use a different quarterly protocol; unrestricted lag_24 and deleted timestamp rows do not reproduce the new information cutoff.

nodes.label: Earlier workflow research assessment
nodes.rationale: This document preserves the earlier workflow results and directs readers to the expanded RTE-risk recommendation for the latest study.

nodes.label: Legacy rte_correction_proxy additive correction
nodes.rationale: RTE-assisted additive correction; not an independent RTE replacement.

nodes.label: Fresh confirmation and authentic-vintage requirement
nodes.rationale: The chronological test was previously explored; forecast vintages, observation publication times and hourly conversion are unverified. Retuning must use validation or fresh prospective data.

nodes.label: Manager report and interactive presentation
nodes.rationale: Uses the frozen expanded run; adds descriptive diagnostics and presentation without model refits or changed selection.

nodes.label: Distinct point, quantile and conformal report identities
nodes.rationale: Report tables preserve separate models. Written quantile-decision scenarios and interactive unchanged-point asymmetric-loss scenarios are different experiments; neither measures euro savings.

nodes.label: Authored content asset boundary
nodes.rationale: User-approved logos, illustrations and content icons belong here; product chrome icons and protected runtime assets remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Shared authored report components
nodes.rationale: Reusable content helpers belong here; protected functionality is imported only through ../../data-app-public.jsx.

nodes.label: Development-frozen combined LightGBM point policy
nodes.rationale: lab__lightgbm__combined__stacked__w1__residual is frozen by development weighted MAE and guardrails. Neutral training weights won; stacked learned predictors do not ensemble all original architectures. Historical RTE availability is assumed and test was previously inspected.

nodes.label: Separately selected native quantile policy
nodes.rationale: Quantile-arm parameters come from point tuning and selection uses overall unweighted development WIS, without a cold-interval guardrail. Rearranged q50 and the quantile point-policy row are distinct from the selected point model.

nodes.label: Fixed split-conformal and CQR comparators
nodes.rationale: Fixed methods use a separate engineered predictor. Absent cold calibration data and time dependence prevent winter-conditional or exchangeability guarantees.

nodes.label: LightGBM correction of supplied RTE D1
nodes.rationale: Predicts actual national demand minus RTE and adds the estimate to RTE. Uses causal histories and monthly learned features; quarterly candidate refits differ from earlier monthly reference schedules.

nodes.label: Cold-tail uncertainty remains inadequate
nodes.rationale: Selected-point residual intervals, separate selected quantiles and fixed conformal/CQR methods all fail critical coverage diagnostics. Calibration has no cold evenings; separate hourly intervals do not establish daily-trajectory or reserve guarantees.

nodes.label: Unseen, vintage-correct and portfolio-level evaluation gate
nodes.rationale: Substantial historical point gains justify further research, while unavailable vintages, prior test exposure, national-to-portfolio mismatch and cold-tail failures block procurement or reserve replacement. Financial claims require prices, settlement rules and one common decision policy.

nodes.label: Frozen-forecast descriptive failure diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Uses matched nonmissing targets without interpolation; missing-hour days lack complete energy/peak metrics. These diagnostics do not select models.

nodes.label: Failure description without causal attribution
nodes.rationale: Measured temperature/calendar context does not establish weather-forecast misses. Missing issue vintages, sparse cold support and inspected failures do not create independent confirmation or financial evidence.

nodes.label: Independent manager report consistency review
nodes.rationale: Review checked saved report/source records; no fitting, replay, source-data edits or frozen-run edits were performed. Consistency checks cannot authenticate historical vintages or establish future reliability.

nodes.label: Point-forecast and quantile-decision scenario distinction
nodes.rationale: Interactive unchanged-point asymmetric losses and written quantile decisions are distinct experiments. Saved retrospective outputs are not authentic issue-time archives.

nodes.label: Missing-target and complete-day support handling
nodes.rationale: The complete delivery grid retains the missing truth, excludes it from hourly scores and omits complete-day energy/peak statistics for the incomplete DST day; no interpolation occurs.

nodes.label: Historical research_v2 pause checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Records an earlier paused execution with incomplete selection/test replay. RESEARCH_RESUME.md later marks this checkpoint as historical provenance; its resume procedure is not current work.

nodes.label: Frozen original research_v2 experiment design
nodes.rationale: National target is shared across country/regional arms. Regional neural models share global univariate parameters; split conformal is calibration and CRPS is a score. Origin/publication assumptions and missing vintages remain explicit.

nodes.label: Same-predictor resubstitution-to-future error gap
nodes.rationale: Compares saved unscaled in-sample error to subsequent raw forecasts from the same fitted predictor. Fallbacks and unavailable unscaled neural gaps are separate; regime shift and overlapping histories prevent formal overfit/bias–variance or independent-quarter claims.

nodes.label: Windowed-neural training/forecast origin-phase mismatch
nodes.rationale: Fixed daily stride and no left padding anchor five windowed architectures at a different intraday phase from the origin-aware bridge. GRU uses different recurrent windows. Validation exposes rather than repairs this restriction.

nodes.label: Bounded complete-policy neural comparison
nodes.rationale: Small neural optimization caps, target-history-only inputs and globally shared univariate regional models differ from engineered tabular policies. Weak executed scores do not establish general architecture inferiority or a unique cause.

nodes.label: Orchestrated wall times are not a hardware benchmark
nodes.rationale: Memory contention, worker scheduling and an explicit pause affect elapsed time; fair compute comparisons require controlled uninterrupted runs and separate budgets/time/memory records.

nodes.label: Original rte_bias_proxy measured failure catalogue
nodes.rationale: Cases use development_policy_selection.json and a predeclared fixed past-out-of-sample residual distribution; they neither select nor retune a policy.

nodes.label: Complete-target daily energy and peak diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Daily energy/peak errors require complete targets and predictions and assume hourly mean power. Measured temperature/holiday changes are descriptive; missing archived weather prevents weather-miss attribution.

nodes.label: Original development-selected RTE rolling bias adjustment
nodes.rationale: Complete policy uses RTE and predeclared past-out-of-sample residual intervals; selected with 2024 development data before test replay.

nodes.label: Original separately selected national GAM
nodes.rationale: Independent-model choice is separate from the best RTE-assisted complete policy; its pooled interval choices cannot be transferred to another policy.

nodes.label: Original cold-tail and prospective-evidence limits
nodes.rationale: Cold upper-tail diagnostics fail despite all-hour coverage. Sparse winter support, absent vintages, previously inspected test data and bounded model-training differences prevent operational or architecture-superiority claims.

nodes.label: Development-selected pooled or conditional residual intervals
nodes.rationale: Selected on released 2024 residuals, then calibrated with released January–June 2025 outcomes. Sparse support backs off through a frozen hierarchy; no point retuning or hourly-to-daily guarantee follows.

nodes.label: Past-temperature origin trigger versus realized-cold diagnostic
nodes.rationale: The actionable trigger uses past temperature available at origin; realized future cold labels are diagnostic/scenario weights only. Shared median/q95 scenario decisions are weighted-MW proxies requiring additional assumptions, not euro costs or procurement optima.

nodes.label: Original research_v2 detailed recommendation
nodes.rationale: Separates frozen complete-policy and independent-model selections. The previously explored historical comparison is retrospective; input provenance/publication assumptions and bounded training remain limitations.

nodes.label: GAM empirical residual and pooled peak intervals
nodes.rationale: Conformal/conditional analyses centered on gam__national do not establish uncertainty for rte_bias_proxy. Origin-proxy triggers differ from realized-cold diagnostic labels; no conditional-coverage guarantee is made.

nodes.label: Original research_v2 unit-test execution record
nodes.rationale: Recorded test outcomes and one optional real-neural integration skip; execution evidence does not authenticate unavailable historical archives.

nodes.label: Publication, future-label and DST integrity checks
nodes.rationale: Named passing tests cover accessible archive versions, strict publication cutoffs, future-data exclusion, missing-target grid preservation and complete DST bridges.

nodes.label: Strict fixed-predictor conformal checks
nodes.rationale: Named tests check finite-sample ranks, insufficient-score behavior, rejection of fallback-only/refitted predictors and strict label availability; these do not supply exchangeability guarantees.

nodes.label: Earlier RTE-assisted study recommendation
nodes.rationale: Own 2024 selection and January–June calibration protocol; previously exposed test is retrospective. Four tabular families add RTE and recent bias via separately retuned direct/residual policies; neural/statistical architectures were not altered.

nodes.label: Earlier regional RTE-residual quantile LightGBM selection
nodes.rationale: Uses national RTE plus national/regional histories, not regional RTE forecasts. Frozen on development data; test scores do not select the winner.

nodes.label: Monthly assisted residual intervals versus fixed conformal comparator
nodes.rationale: Empirical residual intervals belong to the monthly-refitted policy, while split conformal keeps one predictor fixed. Sparse native quantiles receive quantile/interval scores rather than invented CRPS; cold-tail diagnostics fail and no conditional guarantee is established.

nodes.label: RTE-assisted saved unit-test execution record
nodes.rationale: Saved log includes assisted, feature-lab, learned-feature and expanded-risk checks. Its named tests are execution evidence, not proof of genuine historical forecast vintages or production reliability.

nodes.label: Direct/residual target and RTE fallback checks
nodes.rationale: Named tests distinguish direct/residual targets, add RTE exactly once, preserve DST grids, use declared missing-RTE fallbacks and reject post-cutoff training labels.

nodes.label: Causal learned-feature and fixed-CQR integrity checks
nodes.rationale: Named tests enforce release cutoffs and regional-only scope, exclude future actual weather/labels from predictors and weights, preserve quantile keys/missing rows and verify strict fixed-CQR calibration mapping.

nodes.label: Cutoff correctness under unverified historical availability
nodes.rationale: Released-label gates, masked unavailable target lags and earlier-quarter base selection were reviewed without finding additional leakage. This does not verify original RTE vintages, demand revisions or real trading-desk availability; the test was previously inspected.

nodes.label: Overall-WIS selection and fixed-comparator estimand limits
nodes.rationale: The quantile arm minimizes overall unweighted development WIS without a cold-tail guardrail. The fixed engineered comparator excludes monthly learned inputs but retains their historical cold-probability training weights; nominal conditional-quantile and temporal-coverage interpretations require caution.

nodes.label: Zero cold-evening calibration support
nodes.rationale: April 2–June 29, 2025 has zero realized cold evenings. Development support of 102 cold hours across 41 days cannot substitute for held-out winter calibration.

nodes.label: Twenty-three causal-base LightGBM hybrids across thirteen families
nodes.rationale: Original variants supply causal out-of-sample forecasts to new LightGBM combiners with RTE features. This is not native RTE retraining of every architecture, and compact base-model training limitations remain.

nodes.label: Frozen point policy improves matched historical MAE
nodes.rationale: On 8,759 matched hours, frozen point MAE is 719.631 MW versus RTE 1,438.982, rolling bias 1,111.048 and prior selection 806.761. New policies refit quarterly and references monthly; the comparison measures complete policies.

nodes.label: Incremental cold gain and interval protection remain unresolved
nodes.rationale: Prior-policy cold-MAE improvement is 33.915 MW with a 14-day-block interval [-219.577,238.289]. Cold underprediction occurs in 51/66 hours. Native central 90% cold coverage is 53.03%, fixed CQR 63.64%; lower quantile-median test MAE cannot justify post-hoc replacement of the frozen point selection.

nodes.label: Final independent numerical and provenance cross-check
nodes.rationale: The saved review reports 505 numerical checks passing, maximum difference 7.28e-12 MW below 1e-7 tolerance. Final compressed and decompressed hashes are recorded with history after aggregate rewrites. The review did not train, replay or modify predictions.

nodes.label: Development-selected combined-history RTE correction
nodes.source_location: Decision and improvement over RTE, L3-L16
nodes.rationale: LightGBM adds a correction to supplied RTE D1 using national/regional histories, calendar, eligible lags, rolling statistics and historical out-of-sample linear/classifier predictions. Cold-weighted development selection chose ordinary training weights; matched overall MAE improves 49.99% versus RTE.

nodes.label: Cold-evening intervals fail critical-condition coverage
nodes.rationale: The selected-point empirical 90% interval covers 43.94% of 66 cold hours. Separate native quantiles cover 53.03% and fixed CQR 63.64%. The native asymmetric upper tail misses 30.30% against nominal 2.5%; calibration has zero cold evenings.

nodes.label: Retain for unseen research evaluation, not procurement deployment
nodes.source_location: Decision, L3; Recommendation and limits, L24-L30
nodes.rationale: Confirm on unseen data with trustworthy issue vintages and winter-representative calibration. Historical gains do not support production implementation, euro savings or automatic transfer from national consumption to a customer portfolio.

nodes.label: lab__lightgbm__combined__stacked__w1__residual
nodes.rationale: The development-frozen selection passed guardrails and achieves MAE 719.6 MW on 8,759 matched hours. Cold-weighted MAE is 744.7 MW. Incremental cold improvement over the prior assisted policy is not established because its paired interval crosses zero.

nodes.label: Separate quantile and calibration policies with inadequate cold coverage
nodes.rationale: Native central/asymmetric and fixed engineered CQR intervals are distinct policies. Overall-WIS selection lacks a cold-tail guardrail. Exact CRPS applies only to a specified empirical residual distribution, not the sparse native quantile grid; fixed weighted-comparator conditional-quantile semantics remain limited.

nodes.label: Retrospective RTE availability, calibration and business boundaries
nodes.rationale: Use assumed pre-noon RTE D1 at 11:00 Europe/Paris, no D2/05:00 rule. National truth is shared across input views. Calibration ends before June 30, 2025 and has zero cold evenings; the previously inspected 2025–26 test requires future confirmation. No production/procurement implementation or euro savings is claimed.

nodes.label: Saved unit-test run: 124 tests, one optional skip
nodes.rationale: The recorded run reports 124 tests in 38.220 seconds and OK (skipped=1). This is existing execution evidence; semantic extraction does not rerun the suite or establish external vintage provenance.

nodes.label: Causal feature, base-selection and uncertainty arithmetic tests
nodes.rationale: Recorded passing checks cover causal quarterly base selection, exact publication boundaries, future-data invariance, regional-only scope, OOS learned features, fixed CQR mapping, frozen test policy, residual addition, quantile rearrangement and weighted-MAE/pinball/WIS arithmetic.

nodes.label: Optional real DLinear integration test was skipped
nodes.rationale: The bounded real DLinear reproducibility/masking/CPU integration test requires RUN_NEURAL_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 and was skipped in this recorded suite. Passing panel/unit tests must not be presented as execution of that optional integration fit.

nodes.label: Assumed pre-cutoff RTE and observed-history contract
nodes.source_location: L3; Design, L7-L9; Adversarial review, L19
nodes.rationale: RTE D1 is assumed available at an 11:00 Europe/Paris origin. Observations use a strict interval-end-plus-two-hour delay and actual DST grids. National consumption remains the target; regional sums do not replace it. Positive lag length alone does not prove availability.

nodes.label: Engineered histories and chronological learned predictors
nodes.rationale: Origin/target lags, exact-slot statistics, EWMAs, released RTE errors and delivery-day RTE-profile transforms feed models. Ridge/cold/underprediction predictors are generated out of sample using earlier released labels and training-only preprocessing; observed moving averages are not ARIMA innovations.

nodes.label: Causal archived-base hybrids and chronological validation
nodes.rationale: Four tabular families use enhanced features; original variants enter explicit hybrids through hashed OOS archives. Q1 2024 is burn-in, later base choices use released prior outcomes; Q2–Q4 2024 and January–March 2025 validate the new policies. Quarterly new fits differ from monthly reference policies.

nodes.label: Predicted-cold training weights and guarded point selection
nodes.rationale: Use pre-cutoff predicted cold probabilities for training weights and normalized realized-cold-weighted MAE with overall/cold guardrails for selection. Fivefold cold weighting is a research risk scenario, not an electricity-price estimate or guarantee of beating RTE.

nodes.label: Quantiles, conformal comparators and proper-score evaluation plan
nodes.source_location: Design, L14-L15; Primary sources checked, L28-L34
nodes.rationale: Plan central/asymmetric quantiles, pinball, WIS/Winkler, empirical and threshold-weighted CRPS plus fixed-predictor conformal/CQR. Cites forecasting, LightGBM, scoring and conformal sources. Matched block intervals do not make the already seen test untouched; this plan alone asserts no trained winner.

nodes.label: Pinned NeuralForecast and Lightning research backend
nodes.rationale: Install neural dependencies into project-local .research-deps with --no-deps. Pins include neuralforecast 1.7.7 and pytorch-lightning 2.2.5, with supporting forecast, metric and runtime packages. Exact tested runtime versions are saved with research artifacts.

nodes.label: Preserve the existing Intel macOS scientific environment
nodes.rationale: Existing scientific Python supplies Torch 2.2.2 and NumPy 1.26.4 plus scientific dependencies. Isolation avoids upgrading the existing environment; these are project compatibility pins, not claims about current latest package releases.

nodes.label: Pinned tabular, statistical and notebook research dependencies
nodes.rationale: The research requirements extend requirements-validated.txt and pin NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, LightGBM, statsmodels, Torch, PyArrow, nbformat and nbclient. The file records the project execution stack, not an external compatibility certification.

nodes.label: Research stack preserves the Intel Torch pin and isolated neural requirements
nodes.rationale: The general research environment explicitly delegates neural dependencies to requirements-research-neural.txt and retains Torch 2.2.2. It must not be described as upgrading the shared scientific environment.

nodes.label: Unverified hourly lineage and historical source vintages
nodes.rationale: Hourly averaging, interval labels, revisions and original RTE/weather/demand issue archives are unverified. Interval-start, hourly mean-power and interval-end-plus-two-hour availability assumptions define a retrospective benchmark; timestamp agreement does not prove equal intervals or operational availability.

nodes.label: Previously exposed test, preserved targets and business limits
nodes.rationale: Prior EDA exposed the chronological test. Missing targets, peaks and country/regional discrepancies remain reported rather than silently corrected. National demand is a portfolio proxy; no price/settlement/procurement evidence supports euro savings or quarter-hour market alignment.

nodes.label: Earlier workflow: cutoff, DST and matched-population integrity review
nodes.rationale: This historical six-stage implementation review describes post-cutoff mutation tests, released training labels, intact origin groups, UTC 23/24/25-hour grids, unaltered targets, common-eligible scoring and complete fallback policies. It is not a report of the later research_v2 or RTE-risk experiments.

nodes.label: Earlier workflow: immutable forecast evidence and bounded claims
nodes.rationale: The earlier review describes append-only origin ledgers, content-addressed aggregate forecasts, matched partial-day bootstrap counts and explicit interval undercoverage without test retuning. Its statement that deep learning is deferred belongs to this historical workflow; it does not describe the later completed neural experiments. Empty archive schemas and previously exposed tests do not establish operational, financial or conditional-coverage guarantees.

nodes.label: Recorded execution-environment pins dated 2026-10-20
nodes.rationale: The file records exact NumPy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn, SciPy, notebook-tooling and joblib versions for the earlier validated environment. These are saved project pins, not a new runtime check or a claim about the newest available packages.

nodes.label: Portable installation delegates to requirements.txt
nodes.rationale: The validated environment file explicitly directs portable installation to requirements.txt lower bounds. Exact recorded pins and portable minimum constraints serve different purposes and should not be conflated.

nodes.label: Portable scientific and serialization package lower bounds
nodes.rationale: Requirements specify minimum NumPy 1.26, pandas 2.2, matplotlib 3.8, scikit-learn 1.5, SciPy 1.11 and joblib 1.3. Lower bounds do not constitute a full reproducibility lock or prove compatibility of every later version.

nodes.label: Portable notebook execution and export lower bounds
nodes.rationale: Minimum versions are declared for nbformat 5.10, nbclient 0.10, ipykernel 6.29 and nbconvert 7.16. This is a dependency specification; it does not itself demonstrate successful notebook execution.
